headline: Yutai International Q2 profit more than doubles year-on-year, H1 EPS NT$0.87; Vietnam accounts for 67% of profit | ETtoday Politics
summary: Yutai International reported first-half EPS of NT$0.87 and cumulative revenue of NT$1.001 billion. Vietnam accounted for 67% of profit, with its share rising from about 42% a year earlier.
why: Yutai International is a Taiwan-listed company (stock code 7716) with operations in Vietnam. Its half-year results show how its Vietnamese business is driving profit.
